{"consolidated_memory":"## ml/serving/batcher.py Latency Spikes—Two Separate Incidents

**Shared characteristics across both incidents:**
- Component: ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side)
- Problem: latency spike in the batcher
- Repro method: send the mixed-size request trace
- Signal: tail far above the median in the serving histogram
- Test coverage: tests/ml/test_batcher.py
- Stack: Python

**Incident 1: [2026-06-27] Timezone Mismatch**
- Trigger: latency spike only when input list came in empty
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #3614 on branch fix/latency-spike-1
- Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 37 consecutive days

**Incident 2: [2026-08-18] Config Loader Environment Selection**
- Trigger: latency spike only after client had already retried once
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #8781 on branch fix/latency-spike-2
- Outcome: cold start dropped 16 percent, to 346 ms"}
